variants.name: c-11-verification
variants.description: Deterministic validation and manual audit receipt for the C-11 run trace and inspector surface

notes: Frontend typecheck, lint, architecture boundaries, and the Flat 2.0 gate pass.
Six focused files pass with 39 tests; the supported Chromium story passes with one 500-event mount check.
Strict OpenSpec validation and scoped diff checks pass.
The manual audit corrected undersized inspector targets and prevented idle/loading replay states from claiming successful validation.

The first isolated review's critical roving-focus defect is corrected; selected checkpoint inspection, collapsed-root phase selection, resumed-run query persistence, and repeat-copy announcements are also covered.

The second review's local subscription blocker is corrected with independent snapshot status/error UI while remote requests continue; stable live selection no longer recenters and checkpoint refresh preserves selection.
The final isolated review passes with no critical findings; its virtual-focus and pending-run warnings were adopted and covered before OpenSpec verification.
Full frontend Vitest and production build remain deferred to the Wave 4 boundary after C-12.
